projectDescription: Lovable is an AI-powered platform that lets anyone build, deploy, and manage full-stack web apps and websites by describing what they want in plain language.
keyFeatures: Build full-stack apps and websites by chatting with AI in plain language
Agent Mode for autonomous building, Plan Mode for brainstorming, Code Mode for direct edits
One-click publish with Lovable Cloud (hosting, auth, database, file storage)
80+ native connectors including Google Workspace, Stripe, Supabase, Slack, GitHub, and more
Lovable MCP Server for agentic development from Cursor, Claude, and VS Code
Visual editing to tweak layouts, colors, and components without prompting
Design Systems and Workspace Themes for brand consistency across projects
Automatic security scanning on every publish (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001)
GitHub sync from day one — own your code, no lock-in
Enterprise SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, role-based access, and audit logs
Test and Live environments to safely iterate before publishing
Built-in payments via Stripe with subscription and one-time checkout support
194+ production-ready templates for apps, websites, and internal tools
Custom domains, SEO optimization, and server-side rendering included
publicApiSurface: POST /api/build — Lovable API: Build with URL (trigger a build from a URL prompt)
MCP tool: create_project — spin up a new Lovable project
MCP tool: send_message — iterate on a project via chat
MCP tool: read_file — read source files in a project
MCP tool: execute_sql — run SQL against Lovable Cloud database
MCP tool: deploy — trigger a production deploy and get a live URL
MCP tool: list_projects — list all projects in a workspace
Lovable Connect REST connectors — Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Stripe, Supabase, HubSpot, Linear, Notion, Shopify, and 70+ more
Custom MCP server support — connect any MCP-compatible API as a chat connector
GitHub Sync API — two-way sync between Lovable projects and GitHub repositories
